source_brief: Andrew direct sovereign 2026-05-26 ~14:30Z quoted verbatim: 'I don't fully trust that we actually have all endpoints mapped and proceessed to be able to do a cutover. I need some kind of empirical side by side comparison for each data pull by page, what we get from Bloomberg/Yang-Pipeline versus what we get from YCHarts. That takes two forms, the top level is what is the actual endpoint we are pulling for what data point, e.g. "/indices" for tickers BBGAGG SPX etc etc, then bottom level what is the actual values for those indexes that would be displaying on the portal and cross-reference the BBG/Yang-pipeline values with the Ycharts values. I think the best way to do this is start with narrow scope initially, only focusing on Market-Overview page. That means that we have to look at every relevant component and its values: Top/Bottom Performers, Global RSI, U.S. Regime, and all PerformanceHeatMap constituents throughout the 4 tabs. We need to know exactly what data every single field of those is being served by Yang-Pipeline and cross-reference with Y-Chart Values. I would use the most recent date that both yang-pipline data/model.pkls and ycharts has.' On YCharts seat: 'Just use the existing menachem-bundled cookie for testing.'
